sample_data.method: In-memory singleton store initialization and Supabase PostgreSQL migration
sample_data.reset_instructions: Visit http://localhost:3000/dashboard/seed-data to inspect the benchmark edge cases, or execute 'npm run migrate:supabase' in CLI to re-sync all 60 students and 540 marks.

problem_solving_method: Engineered a pure, deterministic GPA and calculation engine using arbitrary-precision arithmetic (Decimal.js) compliant with 100% of national secondary school grading rules (R-10 to R-30), paired with an explainable audit trace generator, automated pre-publication checking lists, real-time score editor, marks sheet ingestion diagnostics, and cohort failure analytics.

R-10.evidence: src/engine/rules.ts:mapGPAToLetterGrade & src/engine/calculator.ts:calculateStudentGPA (Maps GPA 5.0 to A+, 4.0-4.99 to A, 3.5-3.99 to A-, 3.0-3.49 to B, 2.0-2.99 to C, 1.0-1.99 to D, and 0.0 to F)

R-11.evidence: src/engine/rules.ts:evaluateSubjectMark (Dual-component pass constraint: Theory >= 25/75 AND Practical >= 8/25 evaluated independently for PHY, CHE, BIO, HMT, AGR)

R-12.evidence: src/engine/rules.ts:evaluateSubjectMark (Preserves 'AB' token without converting to numeric 0; compulsory absent yields subject GP 0.00 and overall grade F; optional absent yields 0.00 bonus)

R-13.evidence: src/engine/calculator.ts:calculateStudentGPA (Compulsory fail in any of the 6 compulsory subjects overrides final GPA to 0.00 and letter grade to F; raw uncapped GPA retained in audit trace; GPA capped at 5.00)

R-20.evidence: src/engine/rules.ts:calculateOptionalBonus (Bonus = max(0, GP_optional - 2.0) added to 6 compulsory GP sum divided by strict 6.0 divisor)

R-21.evidence: src/engine/rules.ts:mapTotalMarkToGrade (Standard 0-100 subject mark to GP and Letter Grade mapping scale)

R-29.evidence: src/engine/rules.ts:classifyCheckingFlags & src/app/dashboard/checking-lists/page.tsx (Pre-publication verification roster: Optional List GP <= 2.0 or AB, Practical Fail List < 8, Absent List AB; supports multi-list membership and audit sign-off)

R-30.evidence: src/engine/trace.ts & src/components/results/TraceDrawer.tsx (Per-student immutable step-by-step arithmetic narrative and calculation breakdown drawer)

R-IMPORT.evidence: src/engine/marks-importer.ts & src/app/dashboard/import/page.tsx (Marks sheet ingestion supporting CSV/TSV/JSON upload and paste, providing row-by-row rejection diagnostics with exact rule codes and suggested fixes, plus one-click commit)

R-ANALYTICS.evidence: src/app/api/v1/analytics/route.ts & src/app/dashboard/analytics/page.tsx (Cohort pass rate, interactive grade distribution, prominent focus card identifying the subject that failed the most students with root-cause breakdown, and academic intervention roster)

R-LIVE-SYNC.evidence: src/lib/store.ts & scripts/migrate-supabase.ts (Real-time in-memory singleton cache with full Supabase PostgreSQL database synchronization for 60 students and 540 marks)

R-TRANSCRIPTS.evidence: src/app/dashboard/reports/page.tsx & src/components/reports/PrintableReportCard.tsx (Official student academic transcripts and print-ready hub with complete calculation breakdown)

team_members.major_contribution: End-to-end full-stack architecture, deterministic GPA calculation engine (Decimal.js), 26 unit tests covering all 8 benchmark edge cases, R-29 pre-publication checking list system, marks sheet ingestion diagnostics, class failure analytics, and Supabase integration.

major_design_decisions: Decimal.js Arithmetic Engine: Employed arbitrary-precision arithmetic for all grade point summations, divisions, and capping to permanently eliminate IEEE-754 binary floating-point drift.

Decoupled Pure TypeScript Calculation Core: Engine functions (calculateStudentGPA, evaluateSubjectMark, classifyCheckingFlags) are pure functions free of side-effects, enabling 100% testability and instant recalculation.

Comprehensive Marks Ingestion Diagnostics: Built a dedicated parser supporting CSV, TSV, and JSON that performs field-level validation and produces actionable row rejection reports with rule references and fixes.

Root-Cause Subject Failure Analytics: Engineered deep failure classification distinguishing Theory Failures (<25), Practical Failures (<8), and Absences (AB) to highlight the single subject failing the most students.
Hybrid In-Memory + Supabase Architecture: Utilizes a persistent in-memory singleton store for zero-latency UI interaction, seamlessly mirrored to Supabase PostgreSQL.
known_limitations: Currently structured for single examination periods (e.g. Annual Exams). Multi-term cumulative weighted progression (Half-Yearly 30% + Final 70%) is designed and scheduled for Phase 2 implementation.

ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Executed 26 automated unit tests via Vitest verifying all 8 benchmark edge cases, validated Next.js production builds with zero errors, and conducted interactive browser testing across all routes.
